name: Learning-Based Control
description: Introduction to learning-based control, reinforcement learning (RL) for control, RL-methods - policy iteration, value iteration and actor-critic framework, etc., Q-learning for control, adaptive control, approximate dynamic programming, adaptive optimal control, introduction to model predictive control, iterative learning control, data-driven control and identification, Gaussian processes and Bayesian learning for control and identification, case studies.
